sloka: त्रिषु लोकेषु वा राम न भवेत् सदृशः तव ।बलाम् अतिबलाम् चैव पठतः तात राघव ॥१-२२-१४॥
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vā rāma na bhavet sadṛśaḥ tava ।balām atibalām caiva paṭhataḥ tāta rāghava ॥1-22-14॥

translations.english: O Rama, there is none in this world equal to the might of your hands nor does such a person exist in the three worlds.
